games.title: Find the Magic Ball!
games.description: Watch the ball, follow the cups as they shuffle, then choose where you think it is. Change the shuffle speed and style to adjust the challenge.

games.title: Trophy Clash: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.description: Challenge a partner on a 6×6 board. Make lines of four or more to earn trophies; the player with the most trophies when the board fills wins.

games.title: Build Your Ice Cream
games.description: Create a colorful ice cream treat with scoops, sauces, and toppings in this interactive classroom reward game.
games.thumbnailAlt: Illustration of an ice cream cone with colorful scoops

games.title: Gumball Reading Machine
games.description: Prepare and save named word collections before class, choose the correct lesson, and turn reading practice into a playful gumball activity.
games.thumbnailAlt: Illustration of a colorful gumball reading machine
